# BrainRush

> BrainRush is a free trivia game for a group around one shared screen, played in the browser. One person hosts: they read each question out, listen to the spoken answers and mark them right or wrong. Players or teams pick questions from a board of categories and point values, and harder questions are worth more points.

- Up to 6 players or 4 teams, each with their own color.
- A correct answer adds the question's points, a wrong one takes them away.
- Every question has a countdown timer.
- Many questions are in Arabic and English, and some show a picture, such as a flag or a famous place.
- Each device remembers which questions it has played, so new games pick unseen questions first.
- No sign-up or install. It works best on a TV or big screen with the host at the keyboard.

This file lists no questions or answers, on purpose.

## Play

- [Play BrainRush](https://brainrush.integration.ninja/index.html): set up players or teams, pick categories and start a game
- [How to play](https://brainrush.integration.ninja/how-to-play.html): player guide covering setup, the board, answering, scoring and ending the game

## Optional

- [Categories](https://brainrush.integration.ninja/api/categories.php): JSON list of the current categories and how many questions each has
